items.summary: President Luis Inácio Lula da Silva’s victory ended a string of presidential election wins by right-wing candidates in Latin America. His opponent has refused to accept defeat.

items.title: Review: HSBC Quarterly Profit Growth Misses, Sets $1 Billion Buyback
items.summary: HSBC Holdings Plc reported a 32% jump in quarterly profit, missing analyst estimates even as the lender expressed optimism about the rest of the year.

items.title: Review: Two Candidates, Two Israels, One Nation in the Balance
items.summary: As Israel votes, hard-right nationalism competes with the country’s founding ideals. The outcome could shape Israel’s identity for years.

items.title: Review: What Is the Commonwealth? What to Know as King Charles Hosts Meeting in the Caribbean
items.summary: King Charles III is traveling to host a meeting of the leaders of more than 50 nations.

items.title: Review: King Charles Faces High Stakes Test With Caribbean Tour
items.summary: The king will confront calls for reparations and apologies for his country’s colonial past as he attends the Commonwealth heads of government meeting.

items.title: Review: Judge Temporarily Blocks Further Alterations at D.C.’s East Potomac Park
items.summary: A federal judge stopped the Trump administration from cutting trees and prohibited other changes at the park where the president has sought to overhaul a golf course.
